entities.name: Aaron's Rod
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: A walking stick carried by Aaron, brother of Moses, endowed with miraculous power during the Plagues of Egypt. It transformed into a serpent that devoured the Egyptian sorcerers' rods, and later miraculously sprouted buds, blossoms, and ripe almonds overnight as evidence of the exclusive right to the priesthood of the tribe of Levi. Kept in the Ark of the Covenant alongside a vial of manna and the holy anointing oil.
